% fancyvrb's \UseVerb under a frame set for every verbatim block: a block
% that sets frame=none has no border, and the saved text after it is
% inline, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fancyvrb}
\fvset{frame=single}
\SaveVerb{v}|uvf-text_a|
\begin{document}
Before the block.
\begin{Verbatim}[frame=none]
uvf-block
\end{Verbatim}
Text \UseVerb{v} more.
\end{document}
